text.body: prabhuṃ prāṇanāthaṃ vibhuṃ viśvanāthaṃ jagannāthanāthaṃ sadānaṃda bhājāṃ | bhavadbhavya bhūteśvaraṃ bhūtanāthaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 1 || gale ruṃḍamālaṃ tanau sarpajālaṃ mahākālakālaṃ gaṇeśādhipālāṃ | jaṭājūṭagaṃgottaraṃgairviśiṣyaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 2 || mudāmākaraṃ maṃḍanaṃ maṃḍayaṃtaṃ mahāmaṃḍalaṃ bhasmabhūṣādharaṃ taṃ | anādiṃhyapāraṃ mahāmohamāraṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 3 || vaṭādho nivāsaṃ mahāṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ mahāpāpanāśaṃ sadā suprakāśaṃ | girīśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sureśaṃ maheśaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 4 || girīṃdrātmajā saṃgṛhītārthadehaṃ girausaṃsthitaṃ sarvadā sannagehaṃ | parabrahma brahmādibhirvaṃdyamānaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 5 || kapālaṃ triśūlaṃ karābhyāṃ dadhānaṃ padāṃbhojanamrāya kāmaṃ dadānaṃ | balīvardhayānāṃ surāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 6 || śaraccaṃdra gātraṃ gaṇānaṃda pātraṃ trinetraṃ dhaneśasya mitraṃ | aparṇā kalatraṃ sadā saccaritraṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 7 || haraṃ sarpahāraṃ citābhūvihāraṃ bhavaṃ vedasāraṃ sadā nirvikāraṃ | smaśāne vasaṃtaṃ manojaṃ dahaṃtaṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaṃbhumīśānamīḍe || 8 || svayaṃ yaḥ prabhāte naraśśūlapāṇeḥ paṭhet stotraratnaṃ tvihaprāpyaratnaṃ | saputraṃ sudhānyaṃ samitraṃ kalatraṃ vicitraiḥ samārādhya mokṣaṃ prayāti || phalaśṛti ||
